summary: E2E iter30 — Validation of revoke-all-sessions endpoint, JWT iat/jti claims, h11 elimination, and frontend testIDs. Backend: 12/12 tests passed (admin + player revoke flows, sessions_revoked counter, security_logs, refresh-after-revoke=401, headers, rate limit, NoSQL block, JWT claims with 32-hex jti, zero new h11 LocalProtocolError after 30+ varied requests). Frontend: All 6 admin header testIDs (switch-role, mercadopago, marketing, dashboard, revoke-all-sessions, logout) confirmed; /mi-cuenta renders 'Privacidad y seguridad' card with btn-eliminar-cuenta; no critical console errors. KNOWN LIMITATION: React-Native-Web Alert.alert with multi-buttons silently does nothing — tapping revoke-all-sessions-btn or btn-eliminar-cuenta in WEB preview produces no visible confirmation dialog (works on native iOS/Android via Expo). Inconsistency: player JWT lacks jti claim (only admin has it).

minor.issue: Player access_token JWT NOT include 'jti' claim. Decoded payload only has sub/role/jugador_id/nombre/exp/iat. The new admin /api/auth/login has jti — for consistency player tokens should also carry jti so revocation/audit by jti can apply uniformly.

ui_bugs.issue: On WEB preview, tapping fires no visible confirmation dialog (react-native-web Alert.alert is no-op for multi-button alerts). Native button + DOM click both fail to surface the Alert. The button is rendered correctly with testID and red ShieldOff icon, but UX is broken for web users.

Same root cause — Alert.alert multi-button does not render any dialog on react-native-web. Tap produces no visible confirmation flow on web preview. Apple §5.1.1 compliance is fine on native but breaks on web.

react_native_issues.issue: Alert.alert with multi-button arrays is a no-op on react-native-web. Suggested fix: wrap with Platform.OS === 'web' branch using window.confirm or a custom React modal component for web. Reference: /app/frontend/app/admin/index.tsx:64-94 and /app/frontend/app/mi-cuenta.tsx:91-148.

action_items: Add 'jti' claim to player access_token in routers/player_auth.py for consistency with admin tokens (so security_logs/jti-based revocation can be uniform).

(P1, web-only UX) Replace Alert.alert with a cross-platform confirm helper for the two destructive flows (revoke-all-sessions, delete-account). On web, use window.confirm or a React modal; on native keep Alert.alert. This is critical if web preview is also a supported runtime; on native (Expo Go / built apps) the current code works.
critical_code_review_comments: core/security.py revoke-all-sessions endpoint correctly returns sessions_revoked and writes a security_log with accion='revoke_all_sessions' and extra.role+tokens_revoked.
JWT iat/jti are correctly injected for admin tokens (verified 32-hex jti, unique per emission, iat <= now).

Zero new h11 LocalProtocolError lines emitted across 30+ varied requests during this iteration — the ASGI-pure rewrite of SecurityHeadersMiddleware + AdminMutationAuditMiddleware and removal of SlowAPIMiddleware fixed the regression definitively (file remained at 492 historical entries throughout the test run).
Rate limit 5/min on /api/auth/login still triggers 429 from the @limiter.limit decorators alone, confirming the SlowAPI middleware removal did not break the per-route limiter.
seed_data_creation: Created throwaway player +521998890309 (TEST_FEPlayer) via OTP flow for /mi-cuenta verification. Multiple admin logins for revoke-all-sessions classes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: If retesting Alert flows on web, prefer to listen on page.dialog OR query the DOM for an Alert modal — react-native-web's Alert.alert does NOT call window.alert when buttons array has >1 option; it is silently dropped. Use a player JWT injected directly into localStorage (key='padelappretas.player.token', RAW string not JSON.stringify) to bypass OTP flow and reach /mi-cuenta. Admin login redirects via /seleccion → tap 'Ingresar como Organizador' to reach /admin. Rate limit 5/min on /api/auth/login is per-IP shared between tests — sleep 65s between test classes that hit login.
rca_of_issue: Original problem statement focused on validating 7 features post-fix. All backend items validated (12/12 pytest pass). Frontend findings: (1) UI elements rendered correctly with proper testIDs. (2) React-Native-Web's Alert.alert multi-button variant silently fails on web preview — this is a documented platform limitation not a regression from the iter30 changes. Mitigation: use Platform.select / window.confirm wrapper for web. Impact: web preview UX broken for two destructive flows; native (Expo Go) unaffected.
